column1: # RSV fusion (F) glycoprotein antigenic sites Ø-V, in the standard RSV F0
# precursor numbering (McLellan/Graham; Gilman et al. 2016 PLoS Pathog; Mousa

# (verified: furin site KKRKRR at 131-136, fusion peptide at 137, site II
# N262/N268/K272), and the renumbered 5EA3 (A) / 5UDE (B) chains A-C share it,
# so positions map 1:1 for both subgroups.
